data._comment: Zone polygons in floor-plan METRES, not pixels. Camera-independent by design: the homography maps every camera's pixels into this space, so these polygons stay valid when Madhar Sha's real cameras replace CARR. Zone names mirror the proposal's demo vocabulary.
data._entry_line_comment: The counting line for footfall. Sited just inside the doorway rather than across the frame itself, which is how a door counter is actually installed: a shopper hesitating in the doorway would otherwise trip the line repeatedly. `inward` is any vector pointing into the shop; only its side of the line matters, not its length. Crossing this line needs identity to survive two consecutive frames, nothing more, which is why footfall is measured here instead of by counting track ids.
